verses.text: God brought you to life, even though you were dead in your wrongs and sins.
That used to be your whole walk: following the world's current and the ruler of the air's power—the spirit now working in people who disobey.
We all used to live that way too, chasing whatever our bodies and minds wanted. By nature, we were headed for God's anger like everybody else.
But God is rich in mercy! His love for us is huge. 💛
Even when our sins had us dead, he made us alive with Christ. You have been saved by grace!
God raised us up with Christ and seated us with him in heaven, in Christ Jesus.
He did this so, in the ages ahead, he could show just how overflowing his grace is through his kindness to us in Christ Jesus.
By grace you've been saved through faith. This didn't come from you—it's God's gift. 🎁
It isn't something you earned by your works, so nobody gets to brag.
We are God's handiwork, created in Christ Jesus to do good things—things God prepared ahead of time for us to walk in.
So remember: you Gentiles by birth were called ‘uncircumcised’ by those who call themselves ‘circumcised’—a mark made by human hands.
Back then you were separated from Christ, shut out from Israel's citizenship, strangers to the promise covenants, with no hope and no God in this world.
But now, in Christ Jesus, you who were far away have been brought close through Christ's blood.
Christ himself is our peace. He made both groups one and tore down the wall that split us apart.
In his own body, he ended the hostility and set aside the Law of commands and regulations, creating one new humanity from the two and making peace.
Through the cross, he brought both groups back to God in one body and put the hostility to death there. ✝️
He came preaching peace to you who were far away and peace to those who were near.
Through him, both of us have access to the Father in one Spirit.
So you're not outsiders or strangers anymore. You're fellow citizens with God's people and members of God's household.
You're built on the foundation laid by the apostles and prophets, with Christ Jesus himself as the cornerstone.
In him, the whole structure fits together and keeps growing into a holy temple in the Lord.
In him, you too are being built together into a home where God lives by his Spirit. 🕊️
